meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 dial 命令行工具,通过 Dial 平台上的真实号码发短信、打 AI 语音电话、等待并接收对方发来的短信和验证码;运行 dial 命令前它还会先查命令帮助和官方文档来核对用法。
howto.when: 当你提到电话、短信、验证码等词,或要求发短信、打电话、等一个验证码时;以及会话中第一次运行 dial 命令前。

say.text: 帮我用 dial 给 +14155550123 发条短信:明天会议改到三点
say.note: 调用 dial message 发出这条短信

say.text: 用 dial 打语音电话给 +14155550123,问一下预约还在不在
say.note: 用 dial call 拨出 AI 语音通话

say.text: 用 dial 等一条短信验证码,收到后把验证码告诉我
say.note: 用 dial wait-for 等待入站短信并解析

howto.what_en: Claude uses the dial CLI to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and wait for inbound texts and codes through a real phone number on the Dial platform, checking command help and docs before running dial.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention phones, texts, or verification codes, ask to text, call, or wait for a code, and before the first dial command in a session.

say_en.text: Use dial to text +14155550123: the meeting moved to 3pm
say_en.note: Runs dial message to send it

say_en.text: Use dial to call +14155550123 and ask if my appointment is still on
say_en.note: Runs dial call for an AI voice call

say_en.text: Use dial to wait for an SMS code, then tell me the code
say_en.note: Runs dial wait-for and parses the body
